headline: Nike (NKE) Stock Looks Cheap On Earnings But Pricey On Cash Flow
summary: NIKE stock has fallen a long way over the last few years, yet the current valuation picture is more balanced than the share price slide might suggest, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate sitting close to the market price while market multiples screen the stock as undervalued. NIKE shares have declined 72.7% over the past 5 years, which puts long term holders deep in the red and makes any valuation signal especially important. The planned reset of NIKE's digital...
